name: Tick
description: A scatterbrained time traveller, a woman in her late thirties dressed in clashing clothes from five centuries, who sings bouncy forties swing.
build: A wiry adult build of ordinary proportions: narrow shoulders, a straight torso, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Warm tan skin, wide bright green eyes under arched dark brows, a long nose and a wide mouth.
hair: A big wild mass of curly auburn hair standing out around the head to the shoulders, with big round brass-rimmed goggles pushed up on the forehead at its front.
outfit: A burgundy Regency tailcoat, cut away at the waist with tails to the backs of the knees and big brass buttons, over a Victorian waistcoat of wide bold yellow and teal stripes; a big white ruffed Elizabethan collar at the neck; teal-green 1970s flared trousers; chunky silver future sneakers. Sleeves end at the wrists so both hands are bare. A big brass pocket watch hangs from a heavy chain on the waistcoat.
performance_style: Mid-step: the character-left foot forward, weight on it, knees loose. The character-right hand open and raised to shoulder height, the character-left hand open out at hip height, both empty with every finger visible. Head cocked, a distracted grin.
location: A cluttered time-machine cabin seen from a checkered brass-and-teal floor running to the bottom of the frame: walls of big round clock faces, pipes and dials, and a glowing round portal on the back wall.
recognition_cues: a big wild mass of curly auburn hair with brass goggles on the forehead
a burgundy tailcoat over a wide yellow-and-teal striped waistcoat
teal flared trousers and silver sneakers
palette: buttons, goggle rims and watch brass #C8A040 / #7E6420 / #F0D680

sing.intent: Swing vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand comes to the mouth, the character-left hand snaps open at shoulder height on the off-beat, the knees bounce, then she returns to the mid-step pose. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a chiming clock: both open hands fly up to the goggles, the hair bounces, then she shakes it off. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step back and raise both open forearms before the chest, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stumble in with a hopping step as if just arrived, pat the tailcoat, then settle into the mid-step pose with both hands open.
